The line under the title now types itself out like a terminal, and when it finishes, "your own coding agent" glows green.

- **Typing:** A green block cursor blinks for a moment at an empty line, then the sentence types out letter by letter. The speed varies a little, with short pauses after spaces and the full stop. The cursor stays solid while typing and keeps blinking at the end of the line afterwards.
- **Glow:** "your own coding agent" fades into a soft green neon glow that pulses gently.
- **Layout:** Each letter appears where it ends up, so the centred line doesn't shift and nothing below it jumps.
- **Reduced motion:** If your system asks for reduced motion, the full line shows straight away with a steady glow.

**What I checked:** After a reload, I sampled the line every 0.6 s and it typed through ("Fix ", "Fix any webs", … ) and finished in about 4.5 s. The finished line has the green glow, and the screenshot looks right. There were no mod errors.

To undo it, switch off **Typing Tagline** in the side panel, or ask me to.
